fields.description: Accounts the Cativo Auditing page reads, per company. A company with no rows for a purpose uses what its setup implies (IVA Cativo withholding categories, VAT Assessment Settings, accounts 3452/3453/34541). Use Fill from Company Setup to see and keep those.
